follow_ups.title: Laminar backward-facing step at Re_D 800: the reattachment length against the published values
follow_ups.acceptance: Every limit not stated here is registered in the ADR before the run. The reattachment length of the step of expansion ratio 2 at Re_D 800 lies within the published values 11.48 to 12.20 recorded in docs/reference-data.md (section "Wave 30B: incompressible validation data actually read"), by the checks S1 to S3 of ADR 0060 or their registered successors, on current main, in tests the gate runs. Milestone backward-facing-step, headline.
